20: Lester Burnham, a depressed suburban father in a mid-life crisis, decides to turn his hectic life around after developing an infatuation with his daughter's attractive friend.
276: Former London constable Nicholas Angel finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Angel smells something rotten in the idyllic village.
Big cops. Small town. Moderate violence.
532: Two hundred years after Lt. Ripley died, a group of scientists clone her, hoping to breed the ultimate weapon. But the new Ripley is full of surprises … as are the new aliens. Ripley must team with a band of smugglers to keep the creatures from reaching Earth.
788: A psychotherapist journeys inside a comatose serial killer in the hopes of saving his latest victim.
Enter the mind of a killer.
1044: Homer is an orphan who was never adopted, becoming the favorite of orphanage director Dr. Larch. Dr. Larch imparts his full medical knowledge on Homer, who becomes a skilled, albeit unlicensed, physician. But Homer yearns for a self-chosen life outside the orphanage. What will Homer learn about life and love in the cider house? What of the destiny that Dr. Larch has planned for him?
A story about how far we must travel to find the place where we belong.

What makes you different makes you dangerous.
1556: A renowned ophthalmologist is desperate to cut off an adulterous relationship…which ends up in murder; and a frustrated documentary filmmaker woos an attractive television producer while making a film about her insufferably self-centered boss.
It's about love and reality. Faith and delusion. Good and evil. Success and failure.
1812: When a Russian mobster sets up a real estate scam that generates millions of pounds, various members of London's criminal underworld pursue their share of the fortune. Various shady characters, including Mr One-Two, Stella the accountant, and Johnny Quid, a druggie rock-star, try to claim their slice.
A story of sex, thugs and rock 'n roll.
2068: On a desolate country highway, two homeward-bound teens are nearly run off the road by a maniac in a beat-up truck, and later spot him shoving what appears to be a body down a sewer pipe.

The story of the greatest moment in sports history.

There were nine of us. Three are dead...

Everyone had counted them out. But they're about to get back in the game.
3092: A hardened convict and a younger prisoner escape from a brutal prison in the middle of winter only to find themselves on an out-of-control train with a female railway worker while being pursued by the vengeful head of security.

Your most terrifying nightmare and your most frightening reality are about to meet on the streets.

It's a day he'll never forget. Until tomorrow.

It's how you wear the mask that matters.
4372: The life of famed 1930s comedienne Fanny Brice, from her early days in the Jewish slums of New York, to the height of her career with the Ziegfeld Follies, as well as her marriage to the rakish gambler Nick Arnstein.
People who see FUNNY GIRL are the luckiest people in the world!
4628: An unemployed construction worker heading out west stops at a remote farm in the desert to get water when his car overheats. Sidney Poitier as the life-loving ex-GI who one day encounters five nuns escaped from beyond the Berlin Wall...

Mankind's last hope just turned six.

How far would you go to protect your home?
5652: Now that Santa and Mrs. Claus have the North Pole running smoothly, the Counsel of Legendary Figures has called an emergency meeting on Christmas Eve! Never make the weapon the target
6932: Eccentric aliens give a man the power to do anything he wants to determine if Earth is worth saving.

There’s always a way to get in.

If this story ain't true... it shoulda been!

Doctor in charge of K's brother J

29204: A sheriff and his son who are tracking down a group of bank robbers on their way to Mexico, only to discover that they are being stalked by a far more deadly enemy — The Reeker.

32276: A child escapes from Poland during World War II and first heads to Greece before coming of age in Canada.

HE MADE LOVE TO HER TO MAKE HER CONFESS MURDER! Then She Made A Confession That Made Even The Devil's Ears Burn!
32788: Widower Harry Keach is a construction worker who was raised to appreciate the importance of working for a living. Two men with nothing in common... except the blood in their veins.

The simple story of LIFE through the window pane of the house across the street.

Are you ready to become the worst student the school has ever seen?

Henry Dalio, first owner of Jappeloup

Just because you've been together since age 11, you don’t need to stay together forever.

A sly tale of blackmail about a beauty and her boss

They have one lif and they're gonna play it.

It's time for you to know

For The Thrill of The Kill

38932: Suave antiques dealer Alfredo Martelli is picked up by the police with no justification. At the precinct, Martelli realizes what the investigation is all about-- that he is the main suspect in the killing of his wealthy ex-lover. Is he guilty, or is he just a sleaze?

Don't look back or you'll never see anything again.

A Glimpse of the Ways of the Wanderer

When you're the worst detectives on the force, a nursing home is where you hide

A Tale of a Goddess in Love

Come to the crowning of America's comedy King!

A gun in his sock, a tire iron in his belt, and no badge. The story of Eddie. The best ex-cop in the business.

Unlock the secrets of the supernatural.

Martial Arts Action As Never Seen Before!
